searchText: I'm looking at the output of the `/eth/v2/beacon/blocks` call, specifically the `extra_data` field, and it seems that we have some divergence with how this should be returned. Some nodes return `""` for an empty value, others `"0x"`. I know that the execution specs want to see `"0x"`, but I don't think that this design should be carried over to the consensus specs, and it doesn't match what we do with byte arrays anywhere else. Does anyone disagree, or should I raise issues with the relevant repositories to fix this? Revisiting this: it appears that prysm has not implemented the `prepare_beacon_proposer` API endpoint. Is this scheduled to be implemented prior to Wednesday? Also, it appears that `/eth/v2/beacon/blocks` requires a `fee_recipient`, but this should be optional. cc <@!884836500037066862> It isn't implemented yet as far as I know, don't know the timelines, <@884836500037066862> should know so sorry too many channels and totally missed this... the code is on this branch which i am currently working on https://github.com/prysmaticlabs/prysm/pull/10312 for the validator side. the proto is already there for the rpc /api call that <@!311971895828283393> was able to add. double checking if terence already added the logic for it. working on unit tests for my pr will try my best to have the API implemented on the beacon node side before wednesday, still being worked on i think what i linked isnt what you were looking for... the API endpoint I'll try my best to get that in soon what i linked was on the validator side

excerpts.content:
I'm looking at the output of the `/eth/v2/beacon/blocks` call, specifically the `extra_data` field, and it seems that we have some divergence with how this should be returned.  Some nodes return `""` for an empty value, others `"0x"`.

I know that the execution specs want to see `"0x"`, but I don't think that this design should be carried over to the consensus specs, and it doesn't match what we do with byte arrays anywhere else.  Does anyone disagree, or should I raise issues with the relevant repositories to fix this?

excerpts.author: jgm
excerpts.content:
Revisiting this: it appears that prysm has not implemented the `prepare_beacon_proposer` API endpoint.  Is this scheduled to be implemented prior to Wednesday?

Also, it appears that `/eth/v2/beacon/blocks` requires a `fee_recipient`, but this should be optional.
